name: Ink Narrative Workshop
description: Validate and author a deliberately restricted plain-text branching Ink schema; compile existing Ink source with a separately configured compiler.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Validate supported story fields; reject unsupported conditions and effects; report reachability, choices and declarations-only variables.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Preview generated Ink source, reachability and metrics without modifying the game; plain text only.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Walk a structured Ink narrative through JSON array of 0-based choice indexes (bounded, deterministic).

tools.name: routes
tools.description: Return shortest reproducible choice-index traces for reachable branches and endings, unreachable knots, cycles, traps and route-coverage counts.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a NEW genex-ink-<slug>.generated.ink source at the bound game's root; refuses to overwrite existing files.
tools.confirmation: Create a new Ink narrative source at the game root? This is a project write; existing files are protected.

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile root-level Ink source with locally configured inklecate; reject INCLUDE/EXTERNAL; refuse stale source and require confirmation before writing output.
tools.confirmation: Run the configured local inklecate compiler on a game Ink file and write a compiled JSON artifact? If overwrite=true, an existing .ink.json is replaced.

skills.name: branching-narrative
skills.summary: Use this for choice-driven story knots and persistent Ink-compatible narratives; read the plugin workflow and compiler prerequisites first.
